title: Irony
description: A datapack that makes iron more common.
body:
Overview
Introducing the Irony datapack, designed for players who crave more iron in their Minecraft world! This datapack enhances the natural generation of iron ore, allowing you to gather this vital resource more easily and efficiently. Perfect for survival mode players or anyone looking to expand their crafting possibilities.

Features
Increased Iron Ore Generation:

Surface Iron Deposits:

Discover surface-level iron deposits in plains and mountain biomes, ensuring you don’t have to dig deep to find iron.
Enhanced Cave Systems:

Caves now have iron ore clusters that spawn strategically, encouraging exploration and adventure.
Custom Biomes:

New biomes with unique terrain types that feature high concentrations of iron ore.
Installation
Download the Irony datapack.
Place the downloaded file in the /datapacks/ folder of your desired Minecraft world.
Load your world and type /reload in the chat to activate the datapack.
Compatibility
Compatible with 1.18+ Minecraft versions.
Does not interfere with other datapacks or mods.
Why Use This Datapack?
Resource Management: More iron means more tools, armor, and builds, allowing for a more immersive gameplay experience.
Exploration Incentive: The enhanced generation encourages players to explore caves and different biomes.
Customization: Tailor your mining experience without altering the core mechanics of the game.
Conclusion
Whether you’re a seasoned miner or just starting your adventure, the Iron Enrichment datapack is the perfect addition to your Minecraft world. Gather more iron, craft more items, and enjoy a richer gameplay experience!
